(4) is printed σ_ij = (1/V) Σ v_i^c f_i^c with both factors called 'the contact force'; (6) SI: 'f(d) to be a quadratic function' is a quartic written with d and d0 mixed; the fitted coefficients give 166 MPa at 43 μm while the plotted curve of Fig. S5 reads ≈187 MPa; the SI text points to 'Fig. S2' / 'Fig. S3' / 'Fig. S3' where Fig. S4 / S5 / S6 are meant; the angle α of the frustum is not given; (7) Fig. S7 gives ≈66 % porosity for the 100 μm region while the text and the DEM use 56.02 %; (8) Fig. S8 caption 'NMC900505' vs text 'NCM9055'; text 'in-situ nano-mechanical stage' (p.2, once) vs 'micro-mechanical stage'; (9) the six colour bars of Fig. 8 have different ranges; (10) SI author order (… Yikun Wu, Le Yang, Na Li …) differs from the article (… Yikun Wu, Na Li, Le Yang …); (11) Fig. S2 screenshot prints the source / detector distances with the unit 'mm' (10501.3418 / 18054.1973).
